annotations.title: Machine-readable price list and the ways to pay

description: Every endpoint’s per-call price (credits, USD and atomic USDC), the free allowances, the daily quotas, and how an agent pays without a human: x402 in USDC — per call with no key, or as a prepaid top-up of a key — when it is switched on, or a Stripe Checkout link a human pays. Also served at /api/v1/pricing.json. Needs no key, costs nothing, consumes no quota. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/pricing — free; needs no credentials)
